_comment: Hand-labelled pairs for the similarity threshold, pointing at the exact text in
candidates.json. 'same' means the two ARE one concept and reuse is correct;
'same: false' means they are different concepts and merging them would serve the
The designed collision did not materialise: Web Development produced no 'Stack',
so the Stack-the-structure vs Stack-the-tech-stack pair could not be labelled.
The negatives below are the hard cases the generator actually produced, and several
are harsher than that pair would have been - their descriptions differ by a word or
two while the concepts are genuinely distinct.
Contestable pairs were deliberately left out (Heap vs Priority Queue, Present Bias
vs Hyperbolic Discounting). A label nobody would argue with is worth more here than
a larger set, because every one of these sets the threshold.
